capabilities: Mark notes for sync with a glassine frontmatter property
Push edits to Glassine shortly after typing stops
Pull server-side changes back on note open and on a timer
Upload and download embedded images in either direction
Pair multiple vaults as revocable devices
extras: The README warns that the long-lived device token is stored in plain text in the plugin's local data and should be treated like a stored credential; the protocol is documented in the Glassine server repository (documentation/sync-api.md), not in this README.
intentEvidence: an alternative to Glassine's git/obsidian-git adapter that works the same way on desktop and mobile
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync selected notes with a self-hosted Glassine server, and the git-based adapter route does not work the same way on mobile.

relations.evidence: syncs selected notes with a self-hosted Glassine instance over its REST sync API
an alternative to Glassine's git/obsidian-git adapter

requires.name: Glassine author account (browser approval during pairing)

summary: Syncs notes marked with a glassine frontmatter property to a self-hosted Glassine server over its REST API, on desktop and mobile.
